name: tomc-memory
description: Keeps the latest version of facts that changed: prepares pasted history and saved notes for your next task, on CPU.
long_description: TOMC prepares supplied task evidence on CPU, with optional named notebooks and a local context library. Prepared context is not saved unless you turn on saving MCP results (tomc settings --save-mcp-results on); saved contexts are redacted for common secrets and deleted after 30 days. Notes you save in a notebook stay on this computer until you forget or erase them. Context snapshots support portable export and continuation prompts. Numeric context-reduction estimates are separate from saved text and are not API or billing savings. The host owns active-chat compaction; this MCP server does not replace the host's full request history. Optional metadata-only session hooks support default-on processing and persistent per-session pause; installation, host loading and hook trust are required. The first installation needs network access for the runtime and dependencies. Say "Try TOMC Memory" to run a built-in sample. Use get_status for configuration and get_usage_stats for context estimates.

tools.name: try_tomc
tools.description: Try TOMC Memory on a built-in sample; shows real before/after token estimates and saves nothing.

tools.name: prepare_context
tools.description: Prepare supplied history for the next task; nothing is saved unless saving MCP results is on. Budget covers estimated memory tokens.

tools.name: remember_memory
tools.description: Optionally save user-supplied history in a named notebook.

tools.name: recall_memory
tools.description: Prepare an optional notebook's history for the next task.

tools.name: forget_memory
tools.description: Delete a specified notebook, and the contexts prepared from it, when requested.

tools.name: get_usage_stats
tools.description: View local cumulative estimated context reduction for all, today, or 7d (UTC), not API or billing savings.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Inspect configuration, processing settings and declared session state; configuration is not runtime verification.

tools.name: list_contexts
tools.description: List saved prepared-context snapshots without their body.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Read one selected context snapshot as historical evidence.

tools.name: make_handoff
tools.description: Build a self-contained continuation prompt; does not send it.

tools.name: erase_all_memory
tools.description: Erase all TOMC Memory data on this computer, only when the user explicitly asks.
